name: Your agent sees what you change
description: The shopper removes the agent's line; the agent's next look at the cart reflects it.

planSteps.description: Open the home page of this site
Click the 'Your agent' button at the bottom right of the page
Click the task 'Find the Air Jordan 5 in size 9 and add it' and wait for its reply
Close the panel, open /cart and click 'Remove' on the Air Jordan 5 line
Verify the cart shows 'Your cart is empty'
Click the 'Your agent' button at the bottom right of the page
Click the task 'Read me the cart' and wait for its reply
Verify 'Tool calls' ends with view_cart and the reply reads 'Your cart is empty.'
